Created `lru_cache.py` in the workspace with a class `LRUCache` implementing an O(1)-average LRU cache.

Implementation: backed by `collections.OrderedDict` (hash table + doubly linked list). `get(key)` returns the value or `-1` on a miss, and a hit calls `move_to_end` to mark the key most recently used. `put(key, value)` updates an existing key (also refreshing recency) or inserts a new key, evicting the LRU entry first via `popitem(last=False)` when at capacity. `move_to_end`/`popitem` are O(1) and dict lookups average O(1), so both operations are O(1) average.
